speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your appointment. I understand you are experiencing episodes of dizziness and vertigo. To help me determine the cause, can you describe exactly how the dizziness feels, such as if the room is spinning or if you feel faint?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the details; the position-dependent nature of your dizziness is a crucial clue. Given your age and the spinning sensation, have these episodes been triggered specifically by turning your head in bed or looking up, and how long does each episode last?
